about: The capability registry of contract section 7.4, generated from the C# registry. Every baseline feature of protocol 3 is implied by the negotiated version; these ids name optional features. Receivers ignore ids they do not know, and an id is never reused. Ids that start with x. are experimental and work only in a host's developer mode.
